verdict.rationale: The Jules API documents sending a message to the agent within a session. Community reports describe giving Jules feedback or error messages, after which it continued and fixed its work instead of starting over. missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on steering a session mid-execution (beyond a heading-level mention), explicit documentation that messages redirect in-progress work rather than only responding after pauses, and a way to interrupt or stop a running session.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send follow-up instructions to an active agent session to steer its work without restarting

citations.quote: To send a message to the agent:
You’ll be notified when the task completes or needs your input.
Please review the work done so far and provide feedback for Jules to continue.
I gave it the error message and it fixed it.
